headline: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier Blows Out The Josh Allens 171.9-83.76 as Dak Prescott and Patrick Mahomes Tie for the League's Top Score at 45.42
meme_brief: A team named after Josh Allen gets demolished by a team led by Trevor Lawrence and Ja'Marr Chase, while across town the week's single highest scorer (Patrick Mahomes, 45.42 points) still ends up on the losing side of nothing — his team wins anyway, just not because of him specifically being the decider. Also: a 1-9 team spent the week dropping and adding backup quarterbacks five separate times.
recap:
There was no close game this week — the tightest finish still went by 34.14 points, with NateDawg726 outlasting Kirkumcised Penix 170.7 to 136.56 behind Dak Prescott's 45.42 for NateDawg726, a score that tied for the league's best, while Christian McCaffrey's 44.3 on the other side wasn't enough.

The actual story was the carnage at the top. Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier throttled The Josh Allens 171.9-83.76, an 88.14-point margin that was the week's biggest blowout by a wide stretch, fueled by Trevor Lawrence's 33.78 and Ja'Marr Chase's 28.6. The Josh Allens got nothing from Omar Cooper Jr., who started and scored zero (possibly hurt or inactive) while Josh Downs sat on the bench with 13.3 points. They also had a real bench mistake, sitting J.J. McCarthy's 20.12 points in favor of Geno Smith's 5.92, a 14.2-point miss.

Elsewhere, Playing for 2027 rolled LaHorrible 157.98-113.24 behind Patrick Mahomes' 45.42, and mikelanta beat demon44 110.4-57.04 on the strength of George Pickens' 38 points, while demon44 left Brock Purdy's 37.66 on the bench behind Drake Maye's 3.02 — the week's single worst bench decision by margin, a 34.64-point gap. Full Chuba beat Brent Looking 4 His Keys 135.22-97.06 on Joe Burrow's 41.16, and Brent Looking 4 His Keys compounded the loss by benching Mark Andrews' 16.2 for Jakobi Meyers' 4.9, an 11.3-point miss. Silverbacks (100 vs 1) handled Theme From The Bottom 136.3-98.62 behind Jahmyr Gibbs' 40.7, but still found a way to leave Quinshon Judkins' 14.6 on the bench for Devin Singletary's 0.3.
transaction_desk:
Theme From The Bottom's week doubled as a quarterback graveyard tour: five separate free-agent moves, all at zero cost in priority, cycling through Kurtis Rourke, Behren Morton, Joey Aguilar, Max Brosmer, and Athan Kaliakmanis, dropping Stetson Bennett IV, Tyler Goodson, Cooper Kupp, John Metchie III, and Jahdae Walker along the way. Cutting Cooper Kupp in the process to make room for another unproven arm is the kind of move that only makes sense for a team already looking past this season.

Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier added Tyreek Hill and then flipped him the same week for Elijah Higgins at tight end — both uncontested pickups that cost nothing in priority. Brent Looking 4 His Keys picked up Laquon Treadwell, a depth add tied to Alec Pierce, and also added Jaydn Ott, both free with no competing bids. The Josh Allens added Israel Abanikanda as a direct handcuff insurance play behind Javonte Williams, and tacked on tight end Brevyn Spann-Ford — both reasonable, low-cost moves on a roster that lost by 88 points and needed something to show for the week beyond the loss.
trade_desk: The week's only trade sent running back Kaelon Black (25 years old, rookie season) from Brent Looking 4 His Keys to Theme From The Bottom in exchange for a 2028 second-round pick that had originally belonged to Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier. For Brent Looking 4 His Keys, at 4-6 and outside the playoff picture, cashing a rookie running back for a future second makes sense as a step back toward the rebuild. For Theme From The Bottom, sitting at 1-9, adding a player while giving up future draft capital is a curious direction for a team that spent the same week cycling through five different backup quarterbacks looking for anything to stick.

standings_narrative: The top five seeds by record are set for now: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier at 8-2, Silverbacks (100 vs 1) and NateDawg726 both at 7-3, LaHorrible at 6-4, and Full Chuba rounding it out at 5-5. The sixth and final seed goes not to the next-best record but to whoever has the most total points among the rest, and right now that's The Josh Allens, who sit at 5-5 but hold a 67.66-point cushion over the next team in line on points alone — despite having just lost by 88.14 to the league's top team. demon44, at 4-6, is the closest team on points chasing that spot, a game behind the fifth seed. Kirkumcised Penix, Brent Looking 4 His Keys, mikelanta, and Theme From The Bottom round out the group currently outside the picture, with Theme From The Bottom now four games back and mathematically fading.
